title: What It Actually Looks Like to Be Free and Under Authority
caption:
Free and under authority sounds like a contradiction. Galatians 5 says it isn't.

Christ set you free from what was running you, so you could serve. A man who answers to no one answers to himself.

Who's allowed to tell you no?

#faith #godlymen #christianman #freedom #galatians #scripture
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
